bias_and_normalization_parameters: Included in canonical counts; tied parameters assigned once. Unlearned masks/buffers excluded.

models.layout: Article-bounded max1024context/512stride, each predicted target counted once; token and target geometry frozen before scoring
Max256tokens, right padding with attention masks; all25000reviews retained and truncation fraction reported

sampling.primary: K1 at C8192; other budgets and formats are predefined controls/ablations, not outcome-selected primary replacements
sampling.grouping: 128 successive scalars within each canonical parameter, with explicit tail groups
sampling.range_estimator: min/max; no fitting or outlier selection using evaluation scores
sampling.expected_program_controls: Own-format expectation retained for each stochastic format; quantization and sampling errors reported separately

statistics.quality_rule: Both conditionalMC and paired data/seed bootstrap upper bounds must meet each predeclared primary margin against originalBF16 and same-point finite-programBF16. Report all cases regardless of quality; no additional favorable seeds or threshold changes.
statistics.scope: Approximate conditional and bootstrap uncertainty, no formal simultaneous coverage or universal quality claim.

execution_regimes: First verify probability-count reconstruction R1 on complete parameter sets; separately validate operator accumulation R2 for each architecture before any R2 or hardware datapath claim. Do not substitute R1 timing/memory for R2 system costs.
required_before_any_quality_scoring: Complete finite-program/sampler source and raw-state component audits
Pinned checkpoint and dataset file SHA256 verified
Exact unique parameter, alias, bias, normalization and buffer coverage
Deterministic evaluation token/label manifest frozen before scoring
Complete execution and independent statistics/audit protocol frozen
Measured resources and all failure retention/no automatic sampling retries
